description: GET /api/v1/nicehash-rates — public cached NiceHash algorithm paying rates (sat per H/s or Sol/s per day). SHA3X, zkSNARK, Blake256R14, Kadena, and XPHash have no NiceHash paying book (null). No API key required. Market snapshot used for My Rigs NiceHash revenue ($/day), not a rental booking.
name: list_nicehash_rates
title: List NiceHash paying rates
